card.title: Not Dismissed
card.instruction: Keep someone present by treating departure as a privilege only you can grant.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you put your coat on, I'd like to formally conclude our coffee.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only stopped for ten minutes. My bus is due.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll consider an early departure. Sit down while I decide.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The café's closing. They've asked us both to leave.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. We'll wait outside together. Their permission to leave doesn't replace mine.

mechanism: A claims authority to conclude a social visit and refuses to let the cafe's closure substitute for personal permission.
confusable: Unlike wanting more company indirectly, A must explicitly control whether the other person may leave.
comparison: D50-b distinguishes venue permission from personal release; D50-a distinguishes sitting in a taxi from permission to depart.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
